dembrandt-dembrandt-skills-algorithmic-c.description: Derive a full UI palette from one or two brand colours — state variants, brand-tinted greys, semantic colours. Use when building or expanding a colour system.

dembrandt-dembrandt-skills-app-shell.description: Top bar, sidebar rail, app launcher, tenant and environment cue, status bar. Use when designing the persistent shell, a collapsible sidebar, or navigation between apps behind one login.

dembrandt-dembrandt-skills-authentic-pro.description: Product visuals must show the real product with real data. Use when building landing pages, hero sections, screenshots or demo panels.

dembrandt-dembrandt-skills-brand-visual-.description: Shape language across type, radius and icons carries brand personality. Use when starting a design system, picking icons or radius tokens, or reviewing visual consistency.

dembrandt-dembrandt-skills-button-states.description: Rest, hover, active, focus, disabled and loading states, derived from the base colour. Use when designing buttons, links, inputs or any clickable component.

dembrandt-dembrandt-skills-clone-website.description: Rebuild a live web page 1:1 from measurement into Figma, Penpot or code, then verify it. Use when reproducing a page or checking a rebuild against the original.

dembrandt-dembrandt-skills-color-mode-an.description: Light, dark or both, and when a theme selector is worth it. Use when defining a base palette or deciding on dark mode support.

dembrandt-dembrandt-skills-component-fam.description: Buttons, inputs, badges and pills share radius, colour logic, shadow, border and spacing. Use when building or reviewing a component library.

dembrandt-dembrandt-skills-coordinated-d.description: Show a table and its map, diagram, timeline or chart together, with selection synced both ways. Use when data appears in two representations at once.

dembrandt-dembrandt-skills-data-display-.description: View modes, row selection, mass actions, sorting, filters, search and table patterns. Use when designing data tables, listings, file browsers or any collection.

dembrandt-dembrandt-skills-dembrandt.description: Orchestrator that routes a UI/UX task through brand, tokens, layout, components, polish and accessibility. Use for multi-concern work such as a design review, UI build or interface audit.

dembrandt-dembrandt-skills-domain-expert.description: Settings for experts who are not developers — domain language, sane defaults, grouping by professional concept. Use when designing settings panels, solver configuration or constraint editors.

dembrandt-dembrandt-skills-elevation-and.description: Shadows and layering that lift elements above the surface. Use when designing cards, dropdowns, modals, tooltips or any floating element.

dembrandt-dembrandt-skills-extract-desig.description: Extract colours, typography, spacing, components and W3C design tokens from a live website with Dembrandt. Use when you need a site's real tokens or want to seed a design system from it.

dembrandt-dembrandt-skills-form-design.description: Helper text, placeholders, validation and submit behaviour. Use when designing or reviewing a form, input field or data entry UI.

dembrandt-dembrandt-skills-generate-ui-f.description: Pipeline from a URL or DESIGN.md to tokens, decisions and a UI spec. Use when building UI for an existing brand, auditing a design system or fixing visual inconsistency.

dembrandt-dembrandt-skills-gestalt-ui-or.description: Group controls with Gestalt principles so users see what belongs together. Use when laying out components, navigation, toolbars, forms or dashboards.

dembrandt-dembrandt-skills-global-toolba.description: Currency, language, region and unit selectors live in a low-profile header or footer spot. Use when designing locale switchers or product-wide preference controls.

dembrandt-dembrandt-skills-information-a.description: Naming, navigation, a UI that mirrors the data model, confirms for irreversible changes. Use when structuring a large application or naming its entities.

dembrandt-dembrandt-skills-layout-paradi.description: Choose a layout paradigm (feed, board, table, canvas, master-detail, dashboard) and reuse it across screens. Includes a landing page narrative framework. Use when structuring a screen, page template or landing page.

dembrandt-dembrandt-skills-loading-state.description: Spinners, skeletons and staggered reveals that manage wait times. Use when designing loading states, async data or the feel of a slow interface.

dembrandt-dembrandt-skills-marketing-vs-.description: A marketing site and its product may differ in density and scale but share one token layer. Use when the two drift apart, share components or need a single token owner.

dembrandt-dembrandt-skills-micro-interac.description: Small purposeful animations — toggles, animated icons, success moments. Use when designing interactive feedback, success states or loaders.

dembrandt-dembrandt-skills-modal-and-ove.description: Modals, drawers, bottom sheets and popovers, each with its scope and blocking level. Use when designing dialogs, confirmations, side panels or action sheets.

dembrandt-dembrandt-skills-modular-scale.description: Ratio-based type scale where every size relates to the others. Use when defining font sizes or type tokens, or when typography feels arbitrary.

dembrandt-dembrandt-skills-motion-and-st.description: Disney's animation principles and cinematic technique applied to UI motion. Use when designing transitions, scroll animations or onboarding motion.

dembrandt-dembrandt-skills-nielsen-usabi.description: Nielsen's 10 usability heuristics. Use when auditing an interface, designing interaction flows, writing error messages or reviewing usability.

dembrandt-dembrandt-skills-notifications.description: Toasts, inline errors, banners and recovery paths. Use when designing error states, success confirmations, async feedback or in-place editing.

dembrandt-dembrandt-skills-operational-e.description: Dense, linear, status-at-a-glance UI for specialists who use a tool all day. Use when designing dispatch, warehouse, logistics, scheduling or other B2B operations tools.

dembrandt-dembrandt-skills-performance-a.description: Lighthouse audits and Core Web Vitals — LCP, CLS, INP. Use when optimising page load, layout shift, input delay, images, fonts or render-blocking resources.

dembrandt-dembrandt-skills-real-world-me.description: Cards, drawers, carousels and other patterns borrowed from the physical world. Use when designing layout patterns, gestures or navigation paradigms.

dembrandt-dembrandt-skills-repeated-comp.description: Cards, rows, tiles and cells are fixed slot models that stay aligned when content length varies. Use when building or reviewing any repeated component.

dembrandt-dembrandt-skills-responsive-pa.description: Mobile, tablet and desktop are different paradigms, not one layout scaled. Use when designing responsive layouts or deciding what each breakpoint shows.

dembrandt-dembrandt-skills-scroll-areas.description: Avoid inner scroll containers; when unavoidable, one axis at a time. Use when a layout, table or panel might scroll inside the page.

dembrandt-dembrandt-skills-semantic-html.description: Semantic HTML5, SEO basics, alt text, progressive enhancement and SPA concerns. Use when building web UI, reviewing markup or optimising for search.

dembrandt-dembrandt-skills-sizing-units.description: rem, px or relative units for each kind of value. Use when defining spacing and sizing tokens, control heights or media queries, or when a layout breaks under enlarged text.

dembrandt-dembrandt-skills-status-colors.description: Few semantic colours, each meaning one thing, and errors with a way forward. Use when designing status indicators, validation, alerts or error states.

dembrandt-dembrandt-skills-sticky-and-fi.description: Sticky headers, bottom toolbars, floating action buttons and pinned table headers. Use when deciding what stays on screen while the user scrolls.

dembrandt-dembrandt-skills-surface-separ.description: Set a surface apart by one means — border, elevation or fill — and keep opacity for state. Use when designing cards, panels, list rows, toolbars or any container.

dembrandt-dembrandt-skills-tab-navigatio.description: Tabs swap views under a shared context. Use when designing tabbed layouts, settings pages, detail views or dashboards with several data views.

dembrandt-dembrandt-skills-ui-context-an.description: Show where the user is and what their actions affect — breadcrumbs, regions, scope labels. Use when designing deep navigation or multi-section layouts.

dembrandt-dembrandt-skills-ui-density.description: Match information density to platform and user type. Use when designing data tables, dashboards or toolbars, or adapting a desktop product for mobile.

dembrandt-dembrandt-skills-user-flows-an.description: Guided multi-step paths and wizards. Use when designing onboarding, checkout, setup sequences or any multi-step journey.

dembrandt-dembrandt-skills-visual-emphas.description: Size, colour, weight and position mark what matters most. Use when designing button groups, CTAs, cards, dashboards or any layout with a primary action.

dembrandt-dembrandt-skills-wcag-accessib.description: WCAG 2.2 AA compliance as required by the European Accessibility Act. Use when designing, building or reviewing any user-facing interface for accessibility.
